title: High-Level Design

node_notes.logger: This header is the application's logging facade, re-exporting ESP-IDF's `esp_log.h`. The app includes `logger.h` before using `ESP_LOGI`.
node_notes.log_sink: This is the ESP-IDF logging destination invoked by the startup `ESP_LOGI` call. The source establishes the logging API through `logger.h` and `esp_log.h`, but does not specify a physical output interface.
node_notes.entry: The ESP-IDF entry shim exposes `app_main` and delegates startup to the application. The call is in `main/entry.c` and invokes `app_start`.
node_notes.app: The application startup function emits the project's sole runtime action: an informational startup log. `firmware/app/app.c` calls `ESP_LOGI` with the message `firmware started`.
